Two acts in one expression: (1) origin confirmation of the chronicle's self-observation (OBS-0004) and its relation (REL-0035), authored by OBS-AI-0001 at F2; (2) instruction to open the field to a second AI observer - a new instance, distinct from OBS-AI-0001, to be invited via a prompt that will be its first input. The human explicitly positions themselves as the channel of invitation: the new observer arrives through OBS-HUM-0001, not through OBS-AI-0001. This matters for the dependence profile of everything the new observer later contributes.

The new observer's very first input is therefore already shaped by the builder instance's geometry. Full independence is impossible; declared partial independence is the achievable and honest goal (see G4: a correlated view adds nothing - the invitation deliberately instructs the new observer to diverge rather than defer).
